scope.R1: PARTIAL: historical local COCO-CD/Waterbirds mask and subset creation remains unrecovered; not fully reproducible.
scope.credentials: Known sensitive/hidden paths are refused. Explicit code/config membership requires author review; this is not a semantic secret-scanning certification.
scope.current_code: Current explicit first-party roots, not a claim of frozen-runtime identity or dependency closure.
scope.evidence_basis: Pinned reviewed-exporter metadata and raw review/disposition bytes, not a fresh service/completion/scientific audit. Operator completion acknowledgements are not machine grading of Markdown conclusions.
scope.excluded: No datasets, raw RGB/GT, predictions/NPY, weights/models, count/source-feature/transition streams, vendor/dependency trees, old release exports or whole evidence archive.
scope.not_turnkey: Other first-party tool roots, external dependencies and dataset construction are not silently bundled; this is not turnkey reconstruction.
scope.paper: Original whole archives preserved byte-for-byte; raw reviews/disposition are separate post-freeze additions.
scope.publication: Local packet only. No Git, network, push, upload or release action; main author handles any later Zonglin-He/B publication.
scope.science: No metric computation, new experiment, positivity/rating filter, GT permission or overall acceptance claim.
scope.tests: Source presence is not execution evidence; six reference-mutation demonstrations remain NOT RUN by this packaging task.
scope.verification_contract: Completion requires the pinned LOCAL_VERIFY.json, exact three-file output membership and successful archive/manifest byte verification. Any FAILED.json invalidates completion even if a receipt was already written before an ordinary close error.

self_binding: MANIFEST.json and delivery.tar.gz hashes/sizes are bound by external LOCAL_VERIFY.json; no self-hash claim.
